'''Phylon Transport''' was a company that specialized in the production of [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] devices for use on [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Originally a manufacturer of industrial transports, the company was nationalized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and used to produce nonmilitary starships and other devices.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
